commits_data.title: proto_data: Fetch the list of protocol name and keys as GPtrArray
commits_data.message:
proto_data: Fetch the list of protocol name and keys as GPtrArray

The p_get_proto_name_and_key function (not exported), takes an
index into the proto_data list, but is probably only used when
iterating over the entire list. The current way that it is used
is O(N^2). Just return a GPtrArray of with all the strings instead
of iterating the list repeatedly.
